title: Spatial Grounding and Abstract Tripartite Case Metaphors

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian grammar is deeply grounded in space. The three-way distinction (*honnan? hol? hová?*) applied across internal (*-ból, -ban, -ba*), surface (*-ról, -on, -ra*), and adessive (*-tól, -nál, -hoz*) domains serves as the universal template for abstract thought.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When we despair, we fall into a dark container (*kétségbe esünk*); when we trust someone, we admit them inside ourselves (*bízunk benne*); when working on a project, we bear the load on a surface (*dolgozunk rajta*).
